correctness.rationale: For the intact cube over char2, A=sum of commuting coordinate flips satisfies A^2=(d mod2)I. With K=A+epsilon I, K^2=0 and first-coordinate block form proves rank N/2. Deleting one vertex gives B^2=epsilon I+ww^T, Bw=0, and the compression rank lemma (surjectivity K(W)=im K) supplies rank B or rank(B+I)=N/2. Thus even d has one J3(0) and N/2-2 J2(0), whereas odd d has one J1(0) plus N/2-1 J2(1). Kernel growth and periodic-space dimensions yield all q-dependent counts. Independently constructed GF2 matrices for d=2..6 and checked rank(B),rank(B^2) (even d rank B=N/2 and B2=1, odd d rank B=N-2 and B2=N-2), confirming the nonstandard rank decomposition; q powers then follow exact linear algebra.
